title: 泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環
summary: 本課聚焦追蹤泥水循環的壓力、固體與能量收支以及分離設備限制。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on track pressure, solids and energy balances and separation limits in slurry circuits. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「循環系統與控制邊界」與「流速與顆粒輸送」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circuit and control boundaries" and "Velocity and solids transport": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「循環系統與控制邊界」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circuit and control boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。必須在同一時間窗閉合帳目，先界定控制體才可解釋流量異常。 假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環系統與控制邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. Supply-return differences include storage and replenishment as well as excavation, so a common time window and defined control volume are essential before interpreting anomalies. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circuit and control boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「循環系統與控制邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Circuit and control boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 循環系統與控制邊界
knowledge.text: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。必須在同一時間窗閉合帳目，先界定控制體才可解釋流量異常。
knowledge.textEn: A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. Supply-return differences include storage and replenishment as well as excavation, so a common time window and defined control volume are essential before interpreting anomalies.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「循環系統與控制邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Circuit and control boundaries" is correct?
options: 送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。
泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。
單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。
optionsEn: The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage.
A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation.
Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend.
quiz.explanation: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環系統與控制邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Circuit and control boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「循環系統與控制邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Circuit and control boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 泥水的固體體積百分比就是固體質量百分比。
槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: The solids volume percentage in slurry equals its solids mass percentage.
Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「循環系統與控制邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Circuit and control boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄循環系統與控制邊界的資料來源與適用條件。將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for circuit and control boundaries. Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄循環系統與控制邊界的資料來源與適用條件。將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for circuit and control boundaries. Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「循環系統與控制邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Circuit and control boundaries"?
options: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。
optionsEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position.
quiz.explanation: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「循環系統與控制邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Circuit and control boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。
knowledge.textEn: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow.
Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend.
quiz.explanation: 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 流速與顆粒輸送：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 流速影響顆粒是否沉積，也控制摩擦能耗與磨耗，最佳狀態取決於粒徑、濃度及非牛頓特性。平均速度只是起點，彎頭和停流區可局部沉積，不能由一個管段速度保證整線暢通。 假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。 速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流速與顆粒輸送」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Velocity affects deposition, energy and wear, with behavior depending on grading, concentration and non-Newtonian properties. Mean speed is only a starting point because bends and stagnant regions can deposit solids even when one pipe section appears adequate. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity and solids transport” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「流速與顆粒輸送」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照粒徑和固體濃度的合格輸送試驗，檢查彎頭、低點與停機後壓差；流速資料與實際沉積證據並列，由設備工程師評估操作範圍，不直接採用算例速度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss; equipment engineers assess operating range using velocity and actual deposition evidence, not the illustrative speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 對照粒徑和固體濃度的合格輸送試驗，檢查彎頭、低點與停機後壓差；流速資料與實際沉積證據並列，由設備工程師評估操作範圍，不直接採用算例速度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss; equipment engineers assess operating range using velocity and actual deposition evidence, not the illustrative speed. stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓差與泵浦功率」與「固體質量濃度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pressure loss and pump power" and "Solids mass concentration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓差與泵浦功率」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure loss and pump power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。泥水密度與黏度改變會移動工作點，不能只用清水泵曲線推定實際效率或最大可輸送量。 假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓差與泵浦功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power. Slurry density and viscosity shift the operating point, so a clear-water curve alone cannot establish actual efficiency or transport capacity. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses. Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure loss and pump power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓差與泵浦功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure loss and pump power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓差與泵浦功率
knowledge.text: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。泥水密度與黏度改變會移動工作點，不能只用清水泵曲線推定實際效率或最大可輸送量。
knowledge.textEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power. Slurry density and viscosity shift the operating point, so a clear-water curve alone cannot establish actual efficiency or transport capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓差與泵浦功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure loss and pump power" is correct?
options: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。
馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。
泥水的固體體積百分比就是固體質量百分比。
optionsEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power.
Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport.
The solids volume percentage in slurry equals its solids mass percentage.
quiz.explanation: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓差與泵浦功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure loss and pump power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓差與泵浦功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure loss and pump power", which statement holds?
options: 槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。
optionsEn: Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓差與泵浦功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure loss and pump power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄壓差與泵浦功率的資料來源與適用條件。同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pressure loss and pump power. Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄壓差與泵浦功率的資料來源與適用條件。同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓差與泵浦功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure loss and pump power"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。
同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series.
Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data.
quiz.explanation: 同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓差與泵浦功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure loss and pump power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓差與泵浦功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure loss and pump power" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
泥水的固體體積百分比就是固體質量百分比。
optionsEn: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The solids volume percentage in slurry equals its solids mass percentage.
quiz.explanation: 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 固體質量濃度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Solids mass concentration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「固體質量濃度」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Solids mass concentration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泥水密度可估固體體積比例，但須知道液相與顆粒密度且無顯著氣體。質量濃度與體積濃度不同，分離效率與出土量換算使用不同基準時必須明確轉換。 假設ρm=1200、ρw=1000、ρs=2600 kg/m³，Cv=(1200−1000)/(2600−1000)=0.125；質量分率0.271。 把體積濃度當質量濃度會大幅錯估固體產出，含氣又使密度偏低而看似稀漿；錯誤可能導致分離設備負荷及廢土量預估失準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「固體質量濃度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mixture density can estimate solids volume fraction if liquid and grain densities are known and gas is negligible. Mass and volume fractions differ, requiring explicit conversion when assessing separation or excavated-material quantities. Assume ρm=1200, ρw=1000 and ρs=2600 kg/m³; Cv=0.125 and solids mass fraction Cvρs/ρm=0.271. options: 旋流器總回收率就是每個粒徑完全相同的分離率。
槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。
旋流器利用顆粒慣性與流場分級，切割粒徑不是一道所有顆粒都服從的硬邊界。
optionsEn: Overall cyclone recovery equals the separation efficiency at every particle size.
Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.
Cyclones classify through particle inertia and flow, but cut size is not a perfect boundary.
quiz.explanation: 旋流器利用顆粒慣性與流場分級，切割粒徑不是一道所有顆粒都服從的硬邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cyclones classify through particle inertia and flow, but cut size is not a perfect boundary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure transients and pipe elasticity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力暫態與管路彈性」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。含氣、非牛頓介質和支管使簡化水擊關係偏離實際，需分析整個系統而非單一閥前讀值。 假設變速時間比往返波傳時間2L/a短，示意ρ=1200 kg/m³、a=300 m/s、Δv=0.5 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=180 kPa；慢變速不直接適用。 低頻取樣可能完全漏掉短壓峰，管路疲勞卻仍累積；把所有尖峰當電噪音刪除會失去重要證據，反之未校驗感測器也可能製造假水擊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力暫態與管路彈性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves. Assume velocity changes faster than the round-trip wave time 2L/a; illustrative ρ=1200 kg/m³, a=300 m/s and Δv=0.5 m/s give Δp=180 kPa. Slow changes do not directly satisfy this relation. Slow sampling may miss short peaks while fatigue accumulates. Deleting every spike as electrical noise loses evidence, although unverified sensors can also manufacture false transient events requiring independent checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Trace one excavation-volume interval to flow, density, levels and calibration, checking clocks and sample intervals; owner and equipment leads accept remaining gaps explicitly rather than allowing a high completion percentage to conceal missing critical channels. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Report images alone cannot support recalculating solids balances, and an unversioned sensor replacement can create an artificial trend. Both maintenance and geological interpretation then inherit the corrupted history.

steps.title: 泥水資料與工程結案：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slurry-data engineering closeout: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泥水資料與工程結案」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slurry-data engineering closeout” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只保留報表圖片會失去重算固體收支的能力，感測器更換後若未換版本則可能拼接出假趨勢；維護和地質分析都會受錯誤歷程影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Report images alone cannot support recalculating solids balances, and an unversioned sensor replacement can create an artificial trend. Both maintenance and geological interpretation then inherit the corrupted history. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只保留報表圖片會失去重算固體收支的能力，感測器更換後若未換版本則可能拼接出假趨勢；維護和地質分析都會受錯誤歷程影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both maintenance and geological interpretation then inherit the corrupted history.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泥水資料與工程結案」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Slurry-data engineering closeout" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
